description: Sweep of the L2 position along the beam (design +X) of the edited beam expander (--base: the Project written with beam_expander_swap_l2.json). Each sample moves L2 by the value with a rigid transform in the design frame. Both output targets are recorded: expanded_waist (waist_radius_x_mm) changes strongly with spacing because the nearly collimated output has a Rayleigh range of metres and its waist moves by metres per millimetre of defocus; output_beam_radius (beam_radius_mm at the plane 100 mm after L2) changes by less than 0.1 % over the same range. Feasible: expanded_waist PASS; best: smallest |expanded_waist - 1.9961240310077522 mm|.
